meta.region: single released region labelled Ghana; 4-5 annotations per image

metric_defs.signed_mean_err_img: mean over images of (mean annotation - oracle)
metric_defs.signed_median_err: mean over images of (median annotation - oracle)
metric_defs.abs_median_err: mean over images of |median annotation - oracle| (paper-style "median distance")

meta.contrast_def: per subject: metric over images in condition A minus metric over images in condition B; headline = unweighted mean over subjects having both conditions

ordinal_logit.note: logit OrderedModel: mst_annot ~ subject FE + poorly + pose dummies (ref facing_camera) + mask; coef in log-odds (positive = darker); ame_* = average marginal effect on E[MST] (MST units)

ri_subject_plus_image_vc.formula: err ~ poorly + pose_bottom + pose_frontal + pose_side + mask

ri_subject_only.formula: err ~ poorly + pose_bottom + pose_frontal + pose_side + mask

ri_plus_random_slope_poorly.formula: err ~ poorly + pose_bottom + pose_frontal + pose_side + mask

lmm_interaction.formula: err ~ poorly * oracle_c + pose_bottom + pose_frontal + pose_side + mask

d_lighting_by_oracle_level.note: floor/ceiling: oracle 1 subjects cannot err below 0 and oracle 10 cannot err above 0

e_golden_vs_challenging.definition: challenging minus golden, per subject (one image each); oracle identical so signed diff = diff in annotation

hiding.definition: well_lit bias = per-subject mean over well_lit images of (image mean annotation - oracle); groups split by its sign; d_* = poorly_lit minus well_lit per-subject contrasts from (a)
